steps.title: Set up project structure
steps.description: Initialize the Android project with necessary configurations for app metadata and Gradle build environment, including adding required external libraries like OkHttp and Gson.

steps.title: Define backend API schema
steps.description: Create the API schema to specify the 'students' collection and its fields for persistent data storage, including authentication details.

steps.title: Configure Android Manifest
steps.description: Set up application permissions for internet access, define activities for registration, login, main list, and adding/editing students, and remove deprecated 'package' attribute from manifest.

steps.title: Implement API Client for Backend Communication
steps.description: Develop a Java class (BackendApi.java) to handle all network requests for user authentication (register, login, logout) and student data CRUD operations.

steps.title: Create Shared Preferences Manager
steps.description: Implement a utility class (SharedPrefsManager.java) to securely store and retrieve the authentication token and app ID.

steps.title: Design Student Data Model
steps.description: Create a Java class (Student.java) to represent a student object, including fields for name, student ID, and the unique backend ID.

steps.title: Develop Registration UI and Logic
steps.description: Create the layout and activity for user registration (RegisterActivity.java and activity_register.xml) to allow new users to create accounts.

steps.title: Implement Login UI and Logic
steps.description: Build the user interface and backend integration for user login (LoginActivity.java and activity_login.xml), including token storage.

steps.title: Create Main Activity UI for Student List
steps.description: Design the main screen (MainActivity.java and activity_main.xml) to display a list of students, with options to add, edit, or delete them.

steps.title: Implement Student List Adapter
steps.description: Create a custom ArrayAdapter for MainActivity to efficiently display student data in a ListView.

steps.title: Develop Add/Edit Student UI and Logic
steps.description: Build the form (AddEditStudentActivity.java and activity_add_edit_student.xml) for adding new students and modifying existing ones, integrating with backend CRUD operations.

steps.title: Configure Application Startup Flow
steps.description: Adjust MainActivity to check login status on startup and redirect to LoginActivity if the user is not authenticated.

steps.title: Implement Logout Functionality
steps.description: Add a logout option to MainActivity, clearing the session token and returning to the login screen.

steps.title: Handle API Responses and UI Updates
steps.description: Ensure all activities correctly handle successful and error responses from the BackendApi, updating the UI accordingly and showing appropriate messages.

steps.title: Building StudentDataSaver
steps.description: Compile and assemble the Android application to create an installable APK.
